title: 第659章 发现烙印第658章 血巫术卷轴
slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: “黑熊”
率先下去，修斯紧随其后，两人很快便进入了昏暗的地窖里。
地窖的空间狭小逼仄，地面是湿漉漉的石板，墙缝里还长着青苔。
这里漆黑一片，只有前方隐隐能看见一丝白光。
“阁下，他就在前面。”
“黑熊”
指了指前方，脸上的那层黑暗元素，似乎还能自动加持黑暗视觉。
修斯朝白光的方向缓步走去，借着加持在双眼上的黑暗视觉，总算是看清了前方的景象。
那白光源自一道光墙，而光墙后方则躺着一个身着残破灰袍、手脚还被符文绳索紧紧捆住的男人。
他的双目紧闭，呼吸还算平稳，显然是已经陷入了深度昏迷。
这时，“黑熊”
粗重的声音忽然从后方传来：
“我现在把光墙解除。”
话音刚落，他便转过身，轻抚了一下墙边的某块石砖。
下一刻，那堵光墙便骤然一散，化作了无数光点。
修斯并未立刻上前，而是先用精神力扫了一番。
对方赫然是位空池巫师，不过精神力强度也基本到了可以构筑底池的程度。
只是，当他的目光扫过对方胸前时，一枚金色带边的徽章却忽然攫住了他的视线。
“三环家族？”
只见那徽章的背面，赫然铸了三枚紧紧相扣的金环纹样。
“这个巫师是三环家族的成员？你从哪弄来的？”
修斯看向了“黑熊“。
“难道是偷渡过来的？趁当初圣壁破碎的时候？
哪知，“黑熊”
却摇了摇头。
“不，他的身份，在玛兰瑟尔大陆估计还是合法的。”
他刻意压低了声，但在这寂静的地窖里也依然清晰。
“这么跟你说吧，他是我在玛兰瑟尔东部抓捕一位偷渡血族的时候，顺手“救”
下的。”
“没错，他当时被那血族催眠了，成了对方的傀儡。
content_en:
"Black Bear"
He went down first, followed closely by Hughes, and the two soon entered the dark cellar.
The cellar was small and cramped, with wet stone slabs on the floor and moss growing in the cracks in the walls.
It's pitch black here, with only a hint of white light visible in front of you.
"Your Excellency, he is right in front."
"Black Bear"
Pointing forward, the layer of dark elements on his face seemed to automatically empower dark vision.
"Da, da..."
Hughes walked slowly towards the direction of the white light, and with the help of the dark vision blessed by his eyes, he finally saw the scene ahead clearly.
The white light came from a wall of light, and behind the wall lay a man wearing a torn gray robe, his hands and feet tightly bound by rune ropes.
His eyes were closed tightly, his breathing was still steady, and he was obviously in a deep coma.
At this time, "Black Bear"
A rough voice suddenly came from behind:
"I will lift the light wall now."
As soon as he finished speaking, he turned around and gently touched a certain stone brick on the wall.
"Click——"
The next moment, the wall of light suddenly dispersed and turned into countless light spots.
Hughes did not step forward immediately, but first scanned it with his mental power.
The opponent is clearly an empty pool wizard, but his mental strength is basically strong enough to build a pot.
However, when he glanced at the other person's chest, a golden-edged badge suddenly caught his sight.
"Three-ring family?"
On the back of the badge, three closely interlocking golden rings were cast.
"This wizard is a member of the Three Rings family? Where did you get it?"
Hughes looked at the "Black Bear".
"Did they sneak over here? When the holy wall was broken?
Who knows, "Black Bear"
But he shook his head.
"No, his identity is probably still legal in the Malanthel continent. "
He deliberately lowered his voice, but it was still clear in the silent cellar.
"Let me tell you this, he was "rescued" when I arrested a stowaway vampire in the east of Malantheel.
Down. "
"Save? "
"That's right, he was hypnotized by the vampire and became the opponent's puppet.
